name: NexusFieldOps
description: Nexus Field Ops integration layer — bridges the Nexus Field Ops Flutter mobile app to the CleanSmartOS backend. Provides worker dashboard, job notes, FCM push tokens, and offline batch sync. Compatibility: HIGH (7/11 core features covered natively by FSMCore; 4 extended by this module).

nexus_field_ops_analysis.compatibility_score: 7/11 features natively available in FSMCore; 4 added by this module

authentication.description: JWT / Bearer token login, logout, password reset

worker_profile.description: View and update own profile, change password

job_list.description: List assigned jobs with status filtering and pagination

job_detail.description: Full job detail: location, equipment, checklist, photos

photo_capture.description: Before/after photos and customer signature uploaded to job

job_status_update.description: Move job through workflow stages (open → in-progress → done)

dashboard_summary.description: Worker home screen: today's jobs, completion stats, earnings

job_notes.description: Worker adds text notes to a job (visible to dispatcher)

push_notifications.description: FCM device token registration for push notification delivery

offline_sync.description: Queue job updates locally and sync when connectivity restored

gaps_not_addressed: Real-time dispatcher ↔ worker messaging (WebSocket/pusher) — requires separate channel setup
Turn-by-turn route navigation — handled client-side in Flutter via Google Maps SDK
nexus_field_ops_analysis.integration_recommendation: INTEGRATE — the Nexus Field Ops Flutter app can target this backend with minimal adapter work. The existing /api/fsm/v1/* routes cover 7 of 11 features; this module adds the remaining 4 (dashboard, notes, FCM token, offline sync). No structural changes to FSMCore are needed.
